items.stem: What is 20% of 85?
A shirt costs $40 and is on sale for 25% off. What is the sale price, in dollars?
items.explanation: Скидка 25% от 40 — это 10, цена 30 (или сразу 40 · 0.75).

items.stem: 18 is what percent of 72?
A town's population grew from 2,000 to 2,300. What was the percent increase in the population?
items.explanation: Прирост 300 от исходных 2000: 300/2000 = 15% (C). 13% — 300/2300 (от нового значения); 3% и 30% — сдвиг запятой.

items.stem: What number is 150% of 60?
A test has 40 questions. Kim answered 34 of them correctly. What percent of the questions did she answer correctly?
Which expression represents the result of increasing a price p by 8%?
items.explanation: p + 0.08p = 1.08p (A). 0.08p — только надбавка; p + 8 — плюс 8 долларов; 0.92p — уменьшение на 8%.

items.stem: If 30% of a number is 21, what is the number?
items.explanation: 30% числа — это 0.3x = 21, откуда x = 21/0.3 = 70.

items.stem: A meal costs $50. A 15% tip is added to the cost of the meal. What is the total amount paid?
items.explanation: Чаевые 0.15 · 50 = 7.50, всего 57.50 (C). 7.50 — только чаевые; 42.50 — вычли их; 65 — прибавили 15 долларов.

items.stem: Which of the following is equal to 0.4%?
items.explanation: Процент — это сотая часть: 0.4/100 = 0.004 (A). 0.4 — забыли разделить на 100; 0.04 — разделили на 10.

items.stem: A tank is 60% full and currently holds 45 liters of water. How many liters does the tank hold when it is full?
items.explanation: 0.6 · V = 45, V = 75 литров.

items.stem: The price of a backpack decreased from $80 to $60. What was the percent decrease?
items.explanation: Снижение 20 от исходных 80: 25% (B). 33% — 20/60 (от новой цены); 75% — 60/80; 20% — сама разность.

items.stem: In a survey of 250 students, 36% said they prefer tea to coffee. How many of the students surveyed prefer tea?
A savings account pays 2% simple interest per year. How much interest, in dollars, does a deposit of $1,500 earn in one year?
Which of the following is greatest?
items.explanation: Переводим в десятичные: 3/8 = 0.375, 0.36, 37% = 0.37, 0.3. Наибольшее — 3/8 (A).

items.stem: The price of a jacket was increased by 20% and then the new price was decreased by 20%. The final price is what percent of the original price?
items.explanation: 1.2 · 0.8 = 0.96 — 96% (B). 100% — частая ошибка: 20% от большей цены больше, чем 20% от меньшей; 104% и 80% — ошибки.

items.stem: After a 15% discount, a bicycle costs $340. What was the price of the bicycle, in dollars, before the discount?
items.explanation: 340 — это 85% исходной цены: 340/0.85 = 400. Прибавить 15% к 340 (391) неверно.

items.stem: A club had 500 members. The number of members increased by 10% in the first year and by 10% again in the second year. How many members did the club have at the end of the second year?
A store buys an item for $60 and sells it for $75. The markup is what percent of the store's cost?
items.explanation: Наценка 15 от себестоимости 60: 25% (C). 20% — 15/75, доля от цены продажи; 80% — 60/75; 15% — сама разность.

items.stem: The number x is 40% of y, and y is 25% of z. The number x is what percent of z?
A salt solution is 12% salt by mass. How many grams of salt are in 250 grams of the solution?
A city's population is 1.2 million and is projected to decrease by 3% each year. Which expression gives the projected population, in millions, t years from now?
items.explanation: Каждый год остаётся 97%: умножаем на 0.97 t раз (A). B оставляет 3%; C — линейное уменьшение на 0.03 млн; D — рост.

items.stem: The price of a stock fell by 30% and then rose by 50%. The final price was $84. What was the original price, in dollars?
items.explanation: Итоговый множитель 0.7 · 1.5 = 1.05; исходная цена 84/1.05 = 80.

items.stem: In a class, 45% of the students are boys and the rest are girls. There are 33 girls in the class. How many students are in the class?
items.explanation: Девочек 55%: 0.55n = 33, n = 60 (B). 73 — 33/0.45 (взяли долю мальчиков); 78 — 33 + 45; 55 — сам процент.

items.stem: A worker's monthly salary of $3,200 is increased by 6.5%. What is the new monthly salary?
When a number is increased by 35%, the result is 189. What is the number?
A company's sales were 400 units in year 1, 460 units in year 2, and 506 units in year 3. Which of the following statements is true?
choices: Sales grew by 15% from year 1 to year 2 and by 10% from year 2 to year 3.
Sales grew by the same percent each year.
Sales grew by 60 units each year.
Sales grew by 25% from year 1 to year 3.
items.explanation: 60/400 = 15% и 46/460 = 10% (A). Проценты разные (B неверно); прирост 60 и 46 единиц (C); за два года 106/400 = 26.5%, а не 25% (D).

items.stem: A standard bag of chips holds 250 grams. A special bag holds 20% more than the standard bag. How many grams does the special bag hold?
If 15% of a is equal to 25% of b, and b = 36, what is the value of a?
A phone loses 18% of its value each year. One year after it was bought, it was worth $492. How much was the phone worth when it was new?
items.explanation: 492 — это 82% цены: 492/0.82 = 600 (C). 580.56 — прибавили 18% к 492; 403.44 — ещё раз уменьшили; 610 — ошибка.

items.stem: The price of a ticket increased by p percent, from $40 to $46. Later, the price increased by p percent again. What is the price after the second increase?
items.explanation: p = 6/40 = 15%. 46 · 1.15 = 52.90 (B). 52 — прибавили те же 6 долларов; 53.80 и 61 — ошибки в проценте.

items.stem: A 40-liter mixture is 25% alcohol. How many liters of pure alcohol must be added to make a mixture that is 40% alcohol?
A store reduces a price by 20%. A customer then uses a coupon for 10% off the reduced price. The customer's total discount is what percent of the original price?
items.explanation: Остаётся 0.8 · 0.9 = 0.72 цены, скидка 28% (B). 30% — сложили проценты, но второй берётся от меньшей цены; 18% и 32% — ошибки.

items.stem: The value, in dollars, of an investment after t years is V = 2,000(1.06)^t. After how many whole years will the investment first be worth at least 50% more than its initial value?
items.explanation: Нужно 1.06^t ≥ 1.5. 1.06⁶ ≈ 1.419, 1.06⁷ ≈ 1.504 — впервые через 7 лет (B). 8 и 9 лет — простые проценты (50/6 ≈ 8.3) или перестраховка.

items.stem: In 2020, a club had 120 members, and 25% of them were seniors. In 2021, the club had 150 members, and 40% of them were seniors. By what percent did the number of seniors increase from 2020 to 2021?
items.explanation: Старшеклассников было 30, стало 60 — рост на 100%. Разница процентов (15 пунктов) — не процентный рост.

items.stem: If a is 60% greater than b, then b is what percent less than a?
items.explanation: a = 1.6b, b = a/1.6 = 0.625a — на 37.5% меньше (A). 60% — тот же процент в обратную сторону неверен; 62.5% — сколько составляет b.

items.stem: A shop owner increases the price of an item by 25%. By what percent must the new price be decreased to return the item to its original price?
items.explanation: Новая цена 1.25p; чтобы вернуться к p, нужно умножить на 1/1.25 = 0.8, то есть снизить на 20% (A). 25% от большей цены — это больше исходной надбавки.

items.stem: The population of a species decreases by 8% each year. The current population is 25,000. To the nearest whole number, what will the population be 3 years from now?
items.explanation: 25 000 · 0.92³ = 25 000 · 0.778688 ≈ 19 467. Линейная модель (−24% за три года, 19 000) неверна.

items.stem: A company's revenue increased by 20% from 2021 to 2022 and then decreased by 10% from 2022 to 2023. The revenue in 2023 was $5.4 million. What was the revenue in 2021, in millions of dollars?
items.explanation: Множитель за два года 1.2 · 0.9 = 1.08; 5.4/1.08 = 5 (B). 4.86 — применили изменения к 5.4 в прямом направлении; 6 — учли только рост на 20%.

items.stem: Of the 800 students at a school, 35% take Spanish, 25% take French, and 10% take both Spanish and French. How many students take neither Spanish nor French?
items.explanation: Хотя бы один язык: 35 + 25 − 10 = 50%, остальные 50% — 400 учеников (C). 320 — забыли вычесть пересечение (40%); 480 — вычли его дважды.

items.stem: An item's price is p dollars. The price is increased by 12%, and then a $15 discount is applied, giving a final price of $97. What is the value of p?

A course grade is based on two sections: section A counts for 40% of the grade and section B counts for 60%. A student scores 70% on section A and 90% on section B. What is the student's course grade, as a percent?
items.explanation: Взвешенное среднее: 0.4 · 70 + 0.6 · 90 = 28 + 54 = 82 (B). 80 — простое среднее; 84 — веса перепутаны; 160 — сумма.

items.stem: The number of bacteria in a culture increases by 30% every hour. To the nearest 10 percent, what is the percent increase in the number of bacteria over 3 hours?
items.explanation: 1.3³ = 2.197, рост ≈ 119.7% ≈ 120% (C). 90% — сложили 30% три раза; 197% — перепутали множитель и процент роста; 100% — грубая оценка.

items.stem: A $250 coat is discounted by 30%. Then an 8% sales tax is applied to the discounted price. What is the final cost of the coat, in dollars?

Container A holds 300 milliliters of a 10% salt solution, and container B holds 200 milliliters of a 30% salt solution. The contents of the two containers are mixed. What is the percent concentration of salt in the mixture?
items.explanation: Соли 30 + 60 = 90 мл в 500 мл: 18% (B). 20% — простое среднее, но объёмы разные; 40% — сложили проценты; 15% — ошибка.
